Bug_Title: Dm: Creation of ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads (DMI_SCHEDULED_THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_WITH_ZERO_CORE_THREADS)
Bug_Details:
(Javadoc)
A ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads will never execute anything; changes to the max pool size are ignored.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by creating a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads. This ensures that the executor will never execute any tasks, as demonstrated by scheduling a task that should print a message but never does.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method which initializes a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads. This prevents any scheduled tasks from executing. The test then checks for a message indicating the task ran, which it shouldn't, causing the test to fail.
